business_summary: Sojitz Corporation operates as a general trading company worldwide. It is involved in the trading of completed automobiles; assembly and wholesales operations; retail sales operations; quality inspection operations; financing; sale of commercial aircraft, defense and related equipment, and business jets; transportation infrastructure projects; convenience store business; food service business; shopping center management; and real estate development. The company also engages in industrial and urban infrastructure business; new building, second-hand ships, and ship chartering marine business; IPP infrastructure investment, electricity retail, and related service project; and IPP/IWPP infrastructure investment for gas-fired power plant. In addition, it is involved in oil and gas, and LNG business; nuclear power related business; ICT infrastructure projects; industrial machinery, bearings, and automobile and motorcycle parts; marine business; power, energy, and plant business; steel-related business; and resource recycling business. Further, the company offers coal, iron ore, alumina, aluminum, copper, precious metals, ceramics and minerals, coke, and carbon products, as well as nickel, chromium, and niobium; organic, inorganic, functional, and fine chemicals; industrial salt; healthcare and natural products; rare earths; commodity, advanced, and environmentally friendly resins; packaging materials; advanced film; plastic molding machines; liquid crystals, electrolytic copper foil, and printed circuit board electronics materials; and fiber materials and products. Additionally, it provides grains, wheat flour, feed materials, confectionery, compound chemical fertilizers, and construction materials; lumber, plywood, and laminated lumber; housing materials; papermaking; biomass and carbon credit; agriculture; oils and fats; dairy products; imported tobacco; and cotton and synthetic fabrics. The company was founded in 1862 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 소지츠코퍼레이션은 전 세계적으로 종합무역회사로 활동하고 있습니다. 완성차 거래에 참여하고 있습니다. 조립 및 도매 운영; 소매 판매 운영; 품질 검사 작업; 자금조달; 상업용 항공기, 국방 및 관련 장비, 비즈니스 제트기 판매; 교통 인프라 프로젝트; 편의점 사업; 식품 서비스 사업; 쇼핑센터 관리; 그리고 부동산 개발. 이 회사는 또한 산업 및 도시 인프라 사업에도 종사하고 있습니다. 신축, 중고선박, 선박대선 해양사업 IPP 인프라 투자, 전력 소매 및 관련 서비스 프로젝트 가스화력발전소 IPP/IWPP 인프라 투자. 또한 석유 및 가스, LNG 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 원자력 관련 사업; ICT 인프라 프로젝트; 산업용 기계, 베어링, 자동차 및 오토바이 부품; 해양사업; 전력, 에너지, 플랜트 사업; 철강 관련 사업; 및 자원재활용 사업을 하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 석탄, 철광석, 알루미나, 알루미늄, 구리, 귀금속, 세라믹 및 광물, 코크스, 탄소 제품, 니켈을 제공합니다.
